summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expansion for the information/compliance layer behind policy-driven supply-chain shocks. The direct public universe is thin because several pure-play maritime intelligence vendors are private, including Kpler. The strongest US-listed reference anchor is S&P Global via Panjiva, maritime data, and AIS expansion. The more Serenity-relevant discovery lane is Descartes for customs/compliance workflow software, UL Solutions for testing/inspection/certification and responsible sourcing audits, and Spire Global as a speculative small-cap exception whose maritime exposure was materially reduced after selling its commercial maritime business to Kpler. Layer 1B expands the public-stock universe around the information and verification layer that may benefit when route-dependent supply shocks, export bans, tariffs, forced-labor rules, sanctions, defense procurement rules, and critical-material shortages raise demand for trade intelligence, vessel visibility, customs/origin compliance, inspection, and certification. The strongest US-listed fits found in this pass are not commodity producers but software/data and TIC/inspection vendors. Descartes and UL Solutions are the cleanest public mappings; MISTRAS and Spire are underfollowed or speculative-shadow mappings that need sharper revenue-exposure verification. Expanded the universe for the shadow-beneficiary information layer behind policy-driven and route-dependent supply shocks.
